map.：若 ζ=0.5，则 tp = π/(10×√0.75) ≈ 0.363 s，略: If zeta = 0.5, then tp = pi/(10 x sqrt(0.75)) = about 0.363 s, later with less overshoot.
map.由中心频率与带宽求品质因数: Quality factor from center frequency and bandwidth
map.峰值时间随阻尼怎么变？: How does peak time change with damping?
map.ζ 增大分母 √(1−ζ²) 减小、tp 增大，峰值更晚到达但超调更低。: As zeta increases the denominator sqrt(1-zeta^2) shrinks and tp grows, so the peak arrives later but with lower overshoot.
map.峰值时间等于上升时间吗？: Is peak time the same as rise time?
map.不等，峰值时间是首次达最大超调的时刻，上升时间是达终值的某百分比时刻。: No. Peak time is the moment the response first reaches maximum overshoot, while rise time is the moment it reaches a certain percentage of the final value.
